issue.title: Album-level emoji: album.set emoji field and Emoji Slot in the Schema Card details stage
issue.description:
Proposed by bob-cli-mf.10 (note #5), triaged by the bob-cli-mf land agent.

Epic bob-cli-mf (plan:202611/schema_editor_arrange_and_emoji.md) gave every album choice
and bank category emoji prompt a searchable Emoji Slot, backed by the bob-emoji api v1 and
the shared 242f/242g Emoji Slot fragments in bob-ledger-tools. Album-level emoji was an
explicit Non-goal: `bob albums update`'s `album.set` op has no `emoji` field today, so
the Album Schema Card cannot set or change the album's own icon. The header title
(`🗃️ Zettel`) comes from the album note itself.

Proposal: add an `emoji` key to `album.set` in bob-cli (src/native/albums/), with
`split_icon`-compatible storage, an inverse op, and docs/records.md plus json-outputs
updates. Then wire the shared Emoji Slot into the Album details stage of the Schema
Card. Bob must stay the only writer, and the save stays one guarded envelope. Coordinate
the CLI contract change with the bob-plugins Album Schema Card (docs/albums.md).

task_type_fields.proposal: Add an emoji field to bob albums update album.set (with inverse op and docs) and use the shared Emoji Slot for the album's own icon in the Album Schema Card details stage.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: Epic bob-cli-mf listed album-level emoji as a Non-goal and forbade bob-cli writer changes; it needs a new CLI contract field first.

issue.creation_reason: The bob-cli-mf acceptance phase recorded album-level emoji as a deferred follow-up because album.set has no emoji field, so album icons still cannot be picked from the Schema Card.
